summary.text: Clint Dixon, a Republican, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2020 and represents Senate District 45 in Gwinnett and Barrow counties.

paragraphs.text: Dixon founded Longleaf Realty in 2010 and later worked for Hewatt Enterprises; he currently serves as an acquisition manager for Chafin Homes.
Dixon has served as a member of the Gwinnett County Planning Commission.
